opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: Look up a country on World Bank Open Data, check Wikipedia for the capital, then draft an email to a named recipient summarizing GDP, growth, population, capital and currency, then discard it.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data and type the country in the search box, then press Enter
Read GDP, growth and population from the country page
Open Wikipedia, search the country and read capital and currency
Open the mail composer and enter the recipient in To
Enter the summary text in Body

opportunities.name: Book lookup with author bio and reading note
opportunities.description: Search a book on Project Gutenberg, open its record, look up the author on Wikipedia, then add a 'Read:' note with title, author, years, Gutenberg release date and downloads in Notes.
steps: Type the book title into Gutenberg quick search and press Enter
Click the top matching result and read release date and downloads
Open Wikipedia and search the author, press Enter to read life dates
